title: A name matching another of the shop's terms is refused, even inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-14 Fourteen.
  • The shop's own term {Term-B}, due on day 5 of the following month, is deactivated.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-14 Fifth.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name, in capital letters and with two spaces between its words.
  3. Click the Days box.
  4. Replace the Name with {Term-B}.
  5. Click the Days box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name shows what you typed.
  • Step 3: the message "A term called {Term-A} already exists." shows (with the existing term's own spelling), and "Create Credit Term" is disabled.
  • Step 4: the Name reads {Term-B}.
  • Step 5: the message "A term called {Term-B} already exists." shows, although {Term-B} is inactive.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R9, another of the shop's terms: “Name matches another of the shop's terms, active or inactive, ignoring capitals and spaces: "A term called {existing name} already exists."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Name matches one of the shop's terms | "A term called {name} already exists." | Inline error, persists until corrected”
  • S3-R9: “Validation rules and their exact messages, shown under the field:”
